As a IT Consultant/Programmer, you will be responsible for analysing, assessing, designing, developing, testing, implementing maintaining and supporting quality applications that supports the company’s key objectives.

Main responsibilities include:
• Writing software code, automated unit tests, and debugging the code to delivery documented working software that meets the requirements in accordance to FedEx secure code practices, policies and established coding standards.
• Translate business requirements and system requirements into detailed technical specifications or business features and user stories using the SAFe Agile framework.
Provide technical mentoring and guidance to other developers.
• Design application solutions that meet complex business requirements, modelling the solution and implement code reviews and other quality management practices across a team of developers.
• Implement software development design patterns to deliver on complex technical requirements to deliver well-engineered working software that is scalable, resilient, maintainable, performant, secure, fault-tolerant, portable, extensible, reusable, testable and easy to use.
• Design and execute complex application testing for functional and non-functional testing including stress and load testing, building test doubles/hubs, test management data, regression testing and complex scenario and use case management.

Analyst and Support Tasks:
• Consultation and analysis of key systems with Stakeholder.
• Collaborating with the enterprise Applications Team and Operations Team around production incidents involving integration to directly or indirectly ensure their timely resolution/recovery and preventative measures are taken to avoid recurrence and minimize business impact
• Maintenance of operational and end-user documentation
• Planning and technical delivery of integration work packages

• Minimum 2+ years experience using Java JMS API in a Linux/Unix environment.
• Experience in developing Java applications in Cloud Native environment.
• Experience in building microservices using Spring Core and Spring Cloud.

• Experience in TDD and BDD practices using Java & Spring based Junit & BDD frameworks.

• Experience in modern networking, IPV4 stack, ICMP, UDP, TCP/IP, socket programming.
• Experience with working with databases e.g. MSSQL, MYSQL, Informix, Oracle.
• Proven ability to lead the development of software development projects.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or similar
SAFe Agile certification highly desirable

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Systems Test Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our technology systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies, identifying defects, and working collaboratively with development and infrastructure teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions. This role suits a methodical and analytical professional with a strong technical background in software and systems testing, a commitment to quality assurance best practices, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Specify, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test scripts, and test cases to validate the behaviour, functionality, and integrity of ICT systems across multiple platforms and environments.
- Identify, diagnose, and document functionality errors and faults in systems and programming code within established testing protocols, quality standards, and compliance guidelines to ensure systems perform to specification.
- Design and conduct regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure new and updated systems meet defined requirements and business needs.
- Utilise automated test software and frameworks to streamline testing processes, improve test coverage, and increase efficiency across the software development lifecycle.
- Produce clear and comprehensive defect reports, test summary reports, and related quality assurance documentation, ensuring traceability from requirements through to test outcomes.
- Perform systems architecture reviews and assessments, evaluating current and future hardware and software configurations, and contributing recommendations to inform strategic technical direction.
- Collaborate closely with software developers, business analysts, and project managers to clarify requirements, resolve defects, and support timely delivery of system releases.
- Create, review, and maintain technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, instructional materials, technical specifications, and maintenance inventory records.
- Analyse test results and defect trends to identify recurring issues, recommend process improvements, and support continuous quality improvement initiatives across the organisation.
- Participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing a quality assurance perspective throughout the development cycle.
- Assess risks associated with system changes and releases, providing input into risk mitigation strategies and supporting informed decision-making across project and operational teams.
- Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of testing tools, methodologies, and frameworks to ensure the organisation's testing capabilities remain current and effective.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
- Demonstrated experience in ICT systems testing, quality assurance, or a closely related technical role, with a solid understanding of the software development and systems engineering lifecycle.
- Proficiency in writing and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts across functional, non-functional, and regression testing scenarios.
- Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, TestNG, or comparable technologies.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex system faults and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, including test reports, defect logs, operational guides, and system specifications.
- Familiarity with agile and DevOps methodologies and the ability to integrate quality assurance activities into iterative development workflows.
- Solid understanding of systems architecture, network infrastructure, and software integration concepts relevant to enterprise ICT environments.
- Competency with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Zephyr, or similar platforms.
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and organisational skills, with a strong commitment to delivering quality outcomes within agreed timeframes.
## Preferred Qualifications
- ISTQB certification (Foundation Level or above) or an equivalent recognised qualification in software testing or quality assurance.
- Experience working in regulated industries or environments with strict compliance, security, or governance requirements, such as government, finance, or healthcare.
- Exposure to performance and load testing tools such as Apache JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
- Familiarity with cybersecurity testing principles, including vulnerability assessments and secure coding practices.
- Experience with cloud-based environments and platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, and an understanding of how they impact testing strategies.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and associated tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Bamboo.
- A postgraduate qualification or additional certifications in project management, IT governance, or related fields, such as ITIL or PRINCE2, would be highly regarded.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking team that values technical excellence and continuous improvement, where your contributions directly shape the quality of systems used across the organisation.
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and attendance at relevant conferences and events.
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with options for hybrid work arrangements, supporting a healthy work-life balance without compromising on career growth.
- Work on complex, large-scale ICT projects that offer genuine variety and the opportunity to deepen your expertise across diverse technologies and industries.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with a clear pathway for career progression within a growing organisation that invests in its people.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

## ICT Support and Test Engineers (nec)
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Support and Test Engineer to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and quality of our systems and infrastructure. This role combines technical support, quality assurance, and systems testing to ensure seamless operations and adherence to established standards. The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and a solid foundation in ICT systems and environments. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a collaborative setting and is committed to delivering high-quality technical outcomes.
## Key Responsibilities
- Schedule and conduct quality audit inspections across systems, data, and documentation, identifying variations and potential high-risk areas to ensure continued adherence to established standards and procedures.
- Investigate, diagnose, and resolve system problems and performance issues, providing hands-on troubleshooting support for desktops, hardware, software, printers, databases, operating systems, email platforms, and network connectivity.
- Test the functionality, behaviour, and integrity of systems and application code within defined testing protocols and quality frameworks, identifying and documenting errors, faults, and deviations from specification.
- Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance processes, guidelines, and strategies to support system reliability, security, and performance across the organisation.
- Recommend and facilitate corrective action plans to address non-compliance issues identified through ongoing monitoring, auditing, and review of operational processes and procedures.
- Perform organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, providing well-informed recommendations on current and future hardware and software strategies aligned with business needs.
- Develop and deliver technical guidance, training, and support to end users and stakeholders on application software, operational procedures, and best practice usage.
- Communicate and liaise effectively with users and management to promote awareness of quality control standards, data integrity requirements, and ICT compliance obligations.
- Create, review, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, technical specifications, testing reports, and maintenance inventory records.
- Assist in the planning and execution of system upgrades, installations, configurations, and patch management activities to minimise disruption and maintain system availability.
- Monitor and evaluate system infrastructure to proactively identify risks and opportunities for improvement, contributing to the ongoing optimisation of ICT environments.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and project stakeholders to support the delivery of ICT initiatives and ensure quality outcomes are achieved throughout the project lifecycle.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent demonstrated experience in a similar ICT role.
- Proven experience in ICT technical support, systems testing, or quality assurance within a professional environment.
- Strong understanding of testing methodologies, quality assurance frameworks, and audit processes across systems and software.
- Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across a broad range of ICT systems, including hardware, software, operating systems, and network components.
- Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation such as test plans, procedural guides, specifications, and operational manuals.
- Solid knowledge of database management, system security, backup procedures, and infrastructure performance monitoring.
